attempts.prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.
Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: L22 busan_fish_market/key.png, a full-detail location reference, exact native 1536x1024 landscape PNG. Recipe: establish. Wide architectural view down the main aisle of a big covered Busan harbour fish market before dawn, camera 2.0 m above the wet concrete floor, slightly off the aisle centre with one coherent perspective. Named key light: the visible cold-white fluorescent tubes suspended from the dark steel ceiling beams. Full value range, crisp inked structure, calm simple upper corner.
The market hall is an enormous single-storey flat-roofed building, approximately a football pitch in plan and 15 m high inside, with deep horizontal roof beams; render its generous height visibly. Long orderly stall rows flank a clear central walking aisle about 6 m wide. Waist-high rectangular tanks contain recognizable small live fish, crabs and an octopus in separate tanks, with working simple pipe connections; neighbouring shallow stainless trays carry silver mackerel on chipped ice. Battered red plastic round tubs and a few plain white fish boxes sit neatly beside the stalls. Wet concrete reflects the fluorescent strips in broken hand-drawn shapes, with real drain grilles. The back wall closes the aisle: a single heavy insulated steel cold-store door with a visible latch at its lower centre, a small human-size door relative to the huge room. Keep all signs, box faces and price boards completely blank.
Two generic tiny adult fish-market workers only, far enough down the aisle to remain scale accents: one in a rubber apron and boots carrying a box against the torso, another bent slightly to check a tank rim. Correct long-legged adult bodies, about 1.7 m tall; waist-high tanks approximately 1 m; feet firmly on the shared floor plane. No named cast, no other people or foreground portraits. This is a place key: architecture and produce, not an action scene. Slate/grey-blue framework, muted sea-green tank water without supernatural glow, saturated red tubs as the modest accent. Tanks and steel may have crisp wet highlights; everything else keeps clear flat local colours and a single opaque cool cel shadow.
Input 1 is an approved industrial freezer-lane image for ink, cold fluorescent lighting and practical refrigeration-material vocabulary ONLY: do not copy its trucks, alley, layout or people. Input 2 is an approved V2 acting panel for line and cel-colour style ONLY: do not copy any of its characters, costumes, weapons or composition. The scene text controls the whole new layout.
No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.

images.checks: Full-detail market, visible fluorescent key, fish/crab/octopus tanks, ice trays, red tubs, attached pipes, two correctly built tiny workers; no text.
